losses.message: streams without a decoder: DESIGN_PARAMETER_DATA, AUTOGRAPH_DATA, PROP_DATA, VERSION, HOLE_OPERATIONS_DATA, CUSTOM_ITEM_PROP_DATA, GLOBAL_PARAMETER_DATA_CACHE, STANDARD_DESIGN_PROP_DATA, LIGHT_CONFIGURATION_DATA, EXTERNAL_THREAD_OPERATIONS_DATA

the SAB_DATA stream declares save format 33.0, which no verified Spatial ACIS band declares; its records were read with the grammar `acis:save-format-217` declares, and what they decoded is reported as it decoded
state E1 holds a dimension annotation, which the history does not map
state F1 selects its edges by topology signature, which names no edge of the body
the logical of a blind end condition is read as the reversal of the sketch normal
document profile, measurement format, font, hatch, configuration, and version records are not mapped
